title: Find Emotionally Consistent Users
summary: Keep users who reacted to at least five content items and whose most common reaction type accounts for at least 60 percent of their reactions; return user_id, dominant_reaction, reaction_ratio (fraction rounded to two decimals), sorted by ratio descending then user_id ascending.
inputFormat: reactions(user_id int, content_id int, reaction text), primary key (user_id, content_id).
officialConstraints: IDs integers; reaction text; key (user_id, content_id).
tieRules: Sort reaction_ratio descending then user_id ascending. The 60 percent threshold means at most one reaction type can qualify.
edgeRules: Tie for dominant type cannot qualify under the 60 percent rule.
exampleStatus: authored-reference (validation only; not for publication as source examples)
